title: Synthesia Review (2026)
intro: Synthesia is evaluated here as AI software — Synthesia is an AI avatar-presenter video studio for training, enablement, and on-brand explainers. Credits are the shared currency: Basic is free with 1,200 credits/month (~10 minutes) but keeps a logo and blocks MP4 download. Starter is $18/editor/mo billed annually ($29 monthly) with 14,500 credits/year (~120 minutes) and download/logo removal. Creator is $64/mo annual ($89 monthly) with 44,000 credits/year (~360 minutes), API, and interactive video. Enterprise is contact sales (SSO, SCORM, unlimited minutes). Distinct from Runway’s generative-clip studio — Synthesia is talking-head / L&D video, not text-to-shot filmmaking. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s AI methodology (ease of use, AI job fit, output quality, workflow depth, integrations, governance/privacy, scalability, value, model capability), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Synthesia when avatar / training video is the job — not Runway generative clips and not ChatGPT.
verdict: Choose Synthesia when avatar / training video is the job — not Runway generative clips and not ChatGPT. Compare Runway if you need text-to-video filmmaking; Midjourney for stills; ChatGPT only if you paste scripts into a chat. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, usage caps and credit rates on the vendor site before purchase.
